name: William Heard
current_role: Founder, CEO & CIO of Heard Capital LLC (Chicago); independent director of Anterix Inc. (ATEX) since 2024
profile: William E. Heard founded Chicago hedge fund Heard Capital around 2010-11 while in his twenties, after working as a special situations analyst at Stark Investments. The fund runs a concentrated ~20-stock book in tech, media, telecom, financials and industrials and became a major Anterix shareholder (~9.4% in 2024), leading to his board seat at the 900 MHz utility private-LTE spectrum company.
interesting_fact: Named to Fortune's 2020 40 Under 40 in Finance: Heard Capital grew from $35M to over $250M in two years, backed by the Teacher Retirement System of Texas and Vista Equity founder Robert F. Smith.
deep_cut_fact: During the pandemic he told Fortune he had started tracking a new metric: video calls were generating 'a meaningful return on time.'
notes: Anterix is highly relevant to energy/grid podcast (private LTE for utilities). Also sits on City Year Chicago board. IR email is Anterix VP IR Natasha Vecchiarelli (company contact, not his). Heard Capital site is behind Cloudflare; no published direct contact found.
